headline: Lagos Port Congestion Threatens Nigerian Maritime Trade Gains
summary: Persistent congestion around Lagos ports is creating mounting operational constraints for Nigeria's maritime trade, threatening to undermine gains achieved despite N4.6 trillion in revenue.
why: Port congestion increases supply chain friction, demurrage costs, and turnaround times for shipping and logistics companies operating in emerging import markets.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Port bottlenecks disrupt the country's import and export trade flows.
